bang
砰然一聲；猛敲；巨響
with a bang 砰然一聲；with a bang = 轟轟烈烈地；go off with a bang 圓滿成功；bang one's head 撞到頭
The police officer heard a loud bang and quickly grabbed his gun.
警察聽到一聲巨響，迅速拔出槍來。
quote
引述；引文
quote sb as saying... 引述某人說……；quotation n. 引文；quote/unquote 引號內／所謂的
The newspaper quoted the mayor as saying, ‘Two more parks will be built in this city next year.’
報紙引述市長的話：「明年這個城市將再蓋兩座公園。」
raw
生的；未加工的
eat sth raw 生吃某物；raw material 原料；uncooked a. 未煮熟的；unprocessed a. 未加工的
Some vegetables can be eaten raw.
有些蔬菜可以生吃。
freeze
結冰；凍僵；使凍結
freeze, froze, frozen；freeze to death 凍死；freezer n. 冷凍庫；freezing a. 冰冷的；freezing point 冰點；frozen a. 冰凍的；be frozen with fear 嚇呆
The water froze on the road, making it dangerous to drive.
水在路面結冰，使得開車很危險。
freezer
冷凍庫
Put the beef in the freezer.
把牛肉放進冷凍庫。
freezing
冰冷的；嚴寒的
a freezing cold day 嚴寒的一天；freezing point 冰點
The freezing weather closed the bridge and kept most people indoors.
嚴寒的天氣使橋梁封閉，也讓大多數人待在室內。
frozen
冰凍的；凍僵的
be frozen with fear 嚇呆
Mom took the frozen fish from the freezer, so I would defrost it.
媽媽從冷凍庫拿出冷凍魚，所以我要把它解凍。
request
要求；請求
at sb's request 應某人的要求；on request 應要求；for the asking 只要開口；require vt. 要求；requirement n. 要求
My boss thought my report was too lengthy, so I had to cut it short at his request.
老闆認為我的報告太冗長，所以我應他的要求縮短內容。
mental
心理的；精神的
mentally adv. 心理上地；psychological a. 心理的；physical a. 身體的；physical examination 身體檢查；physical education 體育
Lucy is said to have some mental problems. She is a little bit weird.
據說露西有些心理問題，她有點怪怪的。
victim
受害者
fall victim to... 成為……的受害者；fall prey to... 成為……的獵物／受害者；discriminate against... 歧視……；discrimination n. 歧視
Many teenagers fall victim to drugs.
許多青少年成為毒品的受害者。
republic
共和國
republican a. 共和國的；Republican Party（美）共和黨；the Democratic Party 民主黨；democratic a. 民主的
90% stands for the Republic of Korea, more commonly known as South Korea.
ROK 代表大韓民國，也就是一般所稱的南韓。
opposite
相反的；對面的；相反的人／事物；在……對面
hold the opposite view 持相反觀點；quite the opposite 正好相反；opposition n. 反對；oppose vt. 反對；be opposed to + N/V-ing 反對……
I live next to the bank opposite the train station.
我住在火車站對面的銀行旁邊。
superior
較優秀的；上級的；上司
be superior/inferior to... 優於／劣於……；one's superior/inferior 某人的上司／下屬；senior/junior to...；older/younger than...；inferior a. 較差的；劣等的
This car is far superior to that one in terms of comfort.
就舒適度而言，這輛車遠優於那輛車。
inferior
較差的；下級的
be inferior to... 劣於……
Confucius once said, ‘Do not make friends with those who are inferior to us.’
孔子曾說：「毋友不如己者。」
emergency
緊急事件
in case of emergency 萬一發生緊急事故
In Taiwan, in case of emergency, please dial 119.
在臺灣，如遇緊急事故，請撥 119。
emergency room
急診室
the emergency room 急診室；emergency exit 緊急出口；crisis n. 危機
Because of the bad weather, the pilot had to make an emergency landing.
由於天候不佳，飛行員不得不緊急降落。
creative
有創造力的
create vt. 創造；creativity n. 創造力；imaginative a. 富想像力的；inventive a. 有創意的；innovative a. 創新的；original a. 原創的；creative writing 創意寫作；creator n. 創造者；destroyer n. 破壞者
A creative advertisement requires intelligence and imagination.
一則有創意的廣告需要智慧與想像力。
creature
生物
living thing 生物
Humans are creatures of habit.
人類是習慣的動物。
creator
創造者
inventor n. 發明者；destroyer n. 破壞者
Walt Disney was the creator of Mickey Mouse.
華特・迪士尼是米老鼠的創造者。
media
媒體（複數）
medium（單數）；the mass media 大眾傳播媒體
The political party accused the media of being biased.
該政黨指責媒體有所偏頗。
extreme
極端的；極端
go to extremes 走極端；excessive a. 過度的；extremely adv. 極端地；exceedingly adv. 非常；excessively adv. 過度地；exceptionally adv. 異常地
You should handle the problem with extreme caution.
你應該極度小心地處理這個問題。
extremely
極端地；非常
exceedingly / excessively / exceptionally adv.
I was extremely happy upon hearing the good news.
聽到這個好消息時，我非常高興。
plenty
很多；大量
plenty of + 複數名詞／不可數名詞；plentiful a. 充足的
There are plenty of activities to do on the beach during the summertime.
夏季時海灘上有許多活動可做。
wagon
四輪貨車
van n. 廂型車；麵包車
Tom plans to journey across America in a covered wagon.
湯姆打算乘著篷車橫越美國。
van
廂型車；麵包車
I'm moving to my new apartment this Sunday. Would you lend me your van?
我這星期日要搬到新公寓。你可以把廂型車借我嗎？
dare
敢於；膽敢；挑戰
dare sb to + V 激某人做……；challenge sb to + V；I dare (that)...；How dare you...? 你怎敢……？
I dare not tell my parents that I'm getting married soon.
我不敢告訴父母我很快就要結婚了。
scholar
學者
scholarly a. 學者的；有學問的；a scholarly statesman 學者型政治家；scholarship n. 獎學金／學問
The author of this book is also a famous scholar in his country.
這本書的作者也是他國內一位著名學者。
scholarship
獎學金；學問
study on a scholarship 靠獎學金就學
The intelligent young girl is studying at Harvard on a government scholarship.
這位聰明的年輕女孩靠政府獎學金在哈佛就讀。
risk
風險；冒險
take/run the risk of + V-ing 冒……風險；at risk 處於危險之中；risk one's life 冒生命危險；risk + N/V-ing
Parents shouldn't run the risk of leaving their children alone.
父母不應冒險把孩子單獨留下。
loose
寬鬆的；鬆動的
come loose 鬆開；tight a. 緊的
My brother likes to wear loose clothes and pants.
我哥哥喜歡穿寬鬆的衣服和褲子。
persuade
說服；勸服
persuade sb to + V 說服某人做……；talk sb into + V-ing；persuade sb not to + V；talk sb out of + V-ing；Could you dissuade Tom from talking so loudly?；persuasion n. 說服；persuasive a. 有說服力的；convincing a. 令人信服的
Try to persuade Jerry to apologize to the teacher.
試著說服傑瑞向老師道歉。
cone
圓錐體
an ice cream cone 冰淇淋甜筒
I set a warning cone behind the car to avoid further accidents.
我在車後放了一個警示錐，以避免更多事故。
odd
奇怪的；奇數的；零散的
odds n. 機率；strange a. 奇怪的；odd numbers 奇數；even numbers 偶數；1,3,5...；2,4,6...
Paul looks odd today. What's wrong with him?
保羅今天看起來怪怪的。他怎麼了？
breath
呼吸；一口氣
take a deep breath 深呼吸；catch one's breath 喘口氣；a breath of wind 一絲風；breathtaking a. 令人屏息的；breathe vi. & vt. 呼吸；breathe in/out 吸氣／吐氣
I always take a deep breath before going on the stage.
我上臺前總會深呼吸。
release
釋放；發行；釋放／發行
release sb from... 釋放某人脫離……；release a film/movie 發行電影；release names 公布姓名；release tension 舒緩緊張；release a report 發布報告
After ten years in prison, the prisoner was released this morning.
服刑十年後，這名囚犯今天早上獲釋。
temper
脾氣
keep/lose one's temper 忍住／發脾氣
I've never seen Victoria lose her temper.
我從未看過維多利亞發脾氣。
cotton
棉；棉花
a cotton ball 棉球；a cotton swab 棉花棒
All of our T-shirts are made of pure cotton.
我們所有的 T 恤都是純棉製的。
lily
百合
The lilies in the garden are in full bloom.
花園裡的百合正盛開。
straw
吸管；稻草
the last straw 最後一根稻草；hay n. 乾草；Make hay while the sun shines. 把握時機；Finding the missing ring here is like looking for a needle in the hay. 大海撈針
You look very charming when you wear that straw hat.
你戴那頂草帽時看起來很迷人。
flour
麵粉
flour 與 flower 同音；flour the bottom of the bowl 在碗底撒麵粉
To make a cake, you need flour and eggs.
做蛋糕需要麵粉和雞蛋。
tunnel
隧道
A tunnel is being built between the two cities.
兩座城市之間正在興建一條隧道。
quit
停止；離開；辭職
quit, quit, quit；quit smoking 戒菸；give up smoking；stop + V-ing 停止做……；quit one's job 辭職；quit + N/V-ing；continue to + V/V-ing 繼續……
Paula announced that she will quit show business next year.
寶拉宣布明年將退出演藝圈。
intelligent
聰明的
intelligence n. 智慧；wit n. 機智；clever a. 聰明的；bright a. 聰明的
Lisa is intelligent and hardworking, which is why all her teachers like her.
麗莎既聰明又勤奮，所以所有老師都喜歡她。
exhibition
展覽會
be on exhibition 展出中；be on display；exhibit vt. 展示；n. 展覽品；exhibition hall 展覽館
There will be an exhibition of modern sculpture next month.
下個月將有一場現代雕塑展。
